subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Chain Letters: The Original Pyramid
description: Learn Chain Letters: The Original Pyramid in one minute.

hook.text: Send $1 to each person on this list, add your name, and mail it to five friends. Riches await.

buildup.text: Chain letters promised exponential returns. Millions participated in the early 20th century.

discovery.text: They were pure pyramid schemes — early participants profited while latecomers lost everything.

twist.text: Making them illegal didn't stop them. They just migrated to email, then social media.

climax.text: Today's digital chain schemes use cryptocurrency and gift exchanges instead of dollar bills.

punchline.text: The chain letter evolved but never died.
